notes.title: Update v1.0 is out!
notes.notes:
The Update 1.0 is a complete rework of the game.

It is important to mention.

Multiplayer Co-Op for two players (Soon we will allow for 4)

Controller Support

Multiple saves are now possible, you can now save up to four different slots.

Improved Character controller

To give a better game feel, guns and melee weapons have been improved.

New Inventory System and UI Interactions

Added villages containing loot

And many more..

[previewyoutube=z3QivX7Z33Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Small Update #5
notes.notes:
- You can now craft Bolts for the Crossbow at the Workbench (Crossbow will one shot seekers if hit on Head or Chest)
- Fixed SOS signal randomly stop working when more than one Campfire is placed
- Changed Pistol description
- Fixed animals getting de-spawn when still in range
- Decreased luggage and military container spawn delay
- Decreased metal scrap spawn delay

The next update will be focused on content (still, I will try to fix any bug reported).
A roadmap will be posted soon with detailed information for the upcoming updates and what you can expect in the near future

notes.title: Small Update #4
notes.notes:

notes.title: Small Update #3
notes.notes:
- Overall improvements to graphics 
- Added option to disable Seekers if SOS is not active
- If placed on Storage Chest, meat will not decay
- Fixed Meat decay rate
- Increased SOS signal rate speed
- Fixed ambient audio becoming off after day 1

notes.title: Small Update #2
notes.notes:

- Increased Military container outline distance, now it should be easier to spot military loot
- Decreased Seekers spawn rate when SOS signal is off
- Decreased food decay rate
- Stone hammer increased durability
